summary: No new defects found by static review. Both prior fixes and both rebuttals are supported by the inspected code, tests and story notes. Execution-dependent criteria remain NOT_RUN because checks were explicitly prohibited in this read-only sandbox.

checks.criterion: AC1: Tests first, observed failing run, independent oracles and PRD tolerances
checks.evidence: Git history places oracle and covariance-test additions before the implementation. Independent calculations are present at pipeline/tests/polarimetry/expanded_oracle.py:71 and jones_oracle.py:58; neither imports production polarimetry. Test tolerances are set at test_polarimetry_covariance.py:44. A failing run was not observed, and execution was prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC2: F6 and F7 construction asserts Hermitian PSD properties and expected eigenvalues before use
checks.evidence: pipeline/tests/test_polarimetry_covariance.py:105 implements Hermitian and eigenvalue assertions. F6 is constructed from (1, 0.2j, 0) and checked before return at :142-154. Both F7 eigenvalue lists are checked before return at :157-167.

checks.criterion: AC3: F6 powers and F7 CPR ambiguity match the required values
checks.evidence: pipeline/tests/test_polarimetry_covariance.py:194-212 asserts F6 OC, both SC conventions and diagnostics. Lines 257-274 assert equal channel powers, CPR values 3/19 and 1, and their difference. Numerical execution was prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC4: Explicit unitary transformation and comparisons with both oracles on fixtures and 200 random PSD covariances
checks.evidence: Basis entries are defined at pipeline/src/terraluna_pipeline/polarimetry.py:958; normalization and U C U^H are applied at :1322 and :1357. Ordering and transmit vector are declared at :1211-1221. Fixture comparisons appear at test_polarimetry_covariance.py:215-254; the 200-example property covers both conventions and orderings at :1080-1128. These numerical comparisons were not executed.

checks.criterion: AC5: Required convention, rejection of unknown conventions and unverified handedness by default
checks.evidence: pipeline/src/terraluna_pipeline/polarimetry.py:1197-1203 requires convention; :1003-1012 rejects undeclared values before conversion. The output field defaults to False at :1060 and is not overridden by the return at :1392-1403. Tests cover omission, unknown values, default False and caller replacement at test_polarimetry_covariance.py:352-410. No output label claims Mini-RF equivalence.

checks.criterion: AC6: Invalid covariance causes, unpublished values, no repair or clipping, configurable tolerance and open real-data decision
checks.evidence: Validation branches are at pipeline/src/terraluna_pipeline/polarimetry.py:1311-1353; invalid values are blanked by :284-288. Tests at test_polarimetry_covariance.py:513-550 cover the four distinct causes, with tolerance and non-clipping cases at :568-703. The negative-diagonal rebuttal is supported by its separate branch and distinct-cause assertion. scripts/ralph/batches/t2-polarimetry/prd.json:163 records the open real-data tolerance. Runtime outcomes were not verified.

checks.criterion: AC7: Nonpositive denominators, handedness diagnostics and no development-data threshold
checks.evidence: pipeline/src/terraluna_pipeline/polarimetry.py:1375-1389 rejects nonpositive OC and base_SC without epsilon and forms the diagnostic ratio. Tests cover zero OC, near-zero OC, zero base_SC and unrestricted handedness ratio at test_polarimetry_covariance.py:709-753. The open threshold is recorded in prd.json:163, supporting the notes rebuttal. Numerical outcomes were not executed.

checks.criterion: Prior codex2-r1-1 fix: Preserve the handedness term beside large powers
checks.evidence: Static fix verified: pipeline/src/terraluna_pipeline/polarimetry.py:989-991 constructs the difference of quadratic forms, and :1366 evaluates it directly instead of subtracting rounded powers. Targeted regressions and a Fraction-based property are present at test_polarimetry_covariance.py:930-988. Their execution remains unverified.

checks.criterion: Prior codex2-r1-2 fix: Reject components lost by shared scaling
checks.evidence: Static fix verified: pipeline/src/terraluna_pipeline/polarimetry.py:1324-1334 compares normalized components against the carried range while checking original nonzero components, then invalidates every output through the shared classifier. The reported covariance and mixed-magnitude properties are covered at test_polarimetry_covariance.py:1007-1067. Their execution remains unverified.

checks.criterion: Changed paths remain within the story scope
checks.evidence: Only polarimetry.py, test_polarimetry_covariance.py and three files under pipeline/tests/polarimetry/ changed. No configuration, release, application or production mock-data paths changed.
